summary: Verified the WhatsAppMultiBatch copy/share fix on desktop (1280px) and mobile (390px). All 4 preview action buttons work or degrade gracefully with success/info toasts and no uncaught crashes. Login → /products → 'Enviar Lotes WhatsApp' dialog → batch selection → preview → 4 buttons + footer send flow all validated.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby (a11y warning, non-blocking)

critical_code_review_comments: WhatsAppMultiBatch.js line ~519-532: Batch row div has onClick={toggleBatch} AND child Radix Checkbox has onCheckedChange={toggleBatch}. Clicking the checkbox itself toggles twice (net zero selection) because the click bubbles up to the row. Recommend adding e.stopPropagation() on the Checkbox or removing the duplicate handler. Clicking the row area (not the checkbox) works, so end-user selection still functions, but this is a latent bug and it broke initial automation attempts that clicked the checkbox directly.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing batches (lalalalalal 150L, Produto Teste Final 2101L, etc.)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 buttons in WhatsAppMultiBatch preview verified: copy-text-btn shows '✅ Texto copiado!' toast; copy-image-btn (clipboard denied in headless) gracefully falls back to share/download with toasts 'Compartilhamento direto indisponível — imagem baixada.' + 'Imagem baixada!'; share-image-btn falls back to PNG download (lotes_16-07-2026.png); download-image-btn triggers PNG download. Footer 'Enviar WhatsApp' is enabled with 0 phone digits + 1 batch selected; clicking triggers image download fallback and opens web.whatsapp.com popup. Mobile 390px viewport: all 4 buttons render visibly. Only observed JS error is the expected/handled NotAllowedError from clipboard.write in headless (caught inside handleCopyImage and mapped to fallback). To select a batch in automation, click the row's product-name area (NOT the Radix checkbox) because the checkbox click bubbles up and double-toggles.
